Key asks from last call:
- Upgrade to 12 reserved GPUs (Dedicated) with burst to 16 for flu-season peaks.
- Enable Redwood Optimize for automatic batching suggestions, KV-prefix caching, and model quantization guidance to reduce token costs for long clinical notes.
